name: Oscillo
description: An oscilloscope trace: a bright line on a ruled graticule.

code.style: --rule: ( @random(${shapeFrequency}) { :before { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-mask: repeating-linear-gradient(0deg, #000 0 3%, transparent 3% 25%), repeating-linear-gradient(90deg, #000 0 3%, transparent 3% 25%); mask: repeating-linear-gradient(0deg, #000 0 3%, transparent 3% 25%), repeating-linear-gradient(90deg, #000 0 3%, transparent 3% 25%); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } :after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 0; top: @calc(20 + 56 * @abs(@sin(@x * 1.3)))%; width: 100%; height: 10%; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
